column1: # Disposition of every CI-reducer abort whose remedy bullets name a `ci_method`
# (M100). Enumerated by data-raw/enumerate-ci-method-remedies.py; `--check` fails
# when a current site carries no row here, or when a row matches no site.
# disposition:
#   sweep  -- the abort is triggered by DEGENERATE DATA, so a bullet naming
#             another ci_method claims that method survives data which has
#             already defeated one. data-raw/sweep-abort-remedies.R measures it.
#   fence  -- the abort is triggered by a design, an argument, or an engine
#             capability, not by the data being degenerate. The named default is
#             not being asked to survive anything, so there is nothing to sweep.
# Three sites left this ledger at M100 rather than gaining a row: the parametric
# bootstrap's refit-convergence guard, the classical MSE = 0 guard, and the
# npbootstrap observed-degeneracy guard each stopped naming a `ci_method` at all,
# because the sweep found no method usable across their trigger classes. They are
# out of the enumeration by the same predicate that admitted them. Should one
# ever name a method again, it reappears here UNCLASSIFIED and `--check` fails
# until someone re-measures it. That claim holds only while the bullets are
# INLINE in the abort call -- it was briefly false when two guards built theirs in
# a `cause` variable (M100 review F3) -- so `--check` now also fails on any abort
# that splices a variable into its message vector.
